name: australian-aml-ctf
description: Map, review and monitor AML/CTF obligations for Australian legal practices under the tranche 2 reforms using verified official sources, designated-service mapping, legal-professional-privilege handling and human-review gates.

interface.shortDescription: AML/CTF compliance workflows for Australian legal practices.
interface.longDescription: Creates an approved AML/CTF practice profile, maps described legal services to the designated services in table 6 of the amended Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2006, issue-spots a practice's AML/CTF program and customer-due-diligence framework against the Act and the AML/CTF Rules 2025, maps reporting obligations including the tipping-off offence and legal-professional-privilege carve-outs, and monitors pending AUSTRAC guidance. It verifies official publishers, fails closed on unmapped services, and never lodges anything with AUSTRAC or concludes that a matter is suspicious.
defaultPrompt: Create a controlled AML/CTF practice profile for this legal practice before assessing its obligations.
Map whether the services this practice provides are designated services under table 6 of the AML/CTF Act.
Review this practice's AML/CTF program and customer due diligence framework for gaps against the Act and Rules.
Map the AML/CTF reporting obligations and legal-professional-privilege handling for this scenario.
Check the AML/CTF watch-list for AUSTRAC guidance or Rules developments since the last review.
